# CitedRx

> CitedRx is an independent information resource that scores telehealth providers across weight loss, erectile dysfunction, testosterone (TRT), menopause (HRT), mental health, longevity, and gender-affirming care. Every rating is built from clinical trial evidence, independent third-party ratings, and public pricing, not star averages or paid placement, and every claim links back to its primary source.

The CitedRx Score (0-10) weighs five factors: how directly clinical trial evidence applies to what a provider actually prescribes (4 pts), independent third-party rating (2 pts), insurance and prior-authorization support (2 pts), clinical support model such as coaching or monitoring (1 pt), and regulatory standing, including any active FDA warning letters or unresolved litigation (1 pt). Ranking order is never adjusted for referral payment. CitedRx may earn a referral fee when a reader signs up with a provider through a link on the site; this is disclosed on every page that carries a sponsored link and never affects scoring or rank order.

## Treatments

- [Weight Loss (GLP-1)](https://citedrx.com/weight-loss/): All 15 GLP-1 telehealth providers scored and compared, with price, medication tier, and insurance support.
- [Erectile Dysfunction](https://citedrx.com/erectile-dysfunction/): ED telehealth providers scored on evidence and value.
- [Testosterone (TRT)](https://citedrx.com/testosterone/): TRT telehealth providers scored on evidence and value.
- [Menopause (HRT)](https://citedrx.com/menopause/): Menopause hormone therapy telehealth providers scored on evidence and value.
- [Mental Health](https://citedrx.com/mental-health/): Mental health telehealth providers scored on evidence and value.
- [Longevity](https://citedrx.com/longevity/): Longevity-focused telehealth and supplement providers scored on evidence and value.
- [Gender-Affirming Care](https://citedrx.com/gender-affirming-hrt/): Gender-affirming hormone therapy telehealth providers scored on evidence and value.
- [Find My GLP-1 Match](https://citedrx.com/weight-loss/find-my-match/): AI matcher that recommends a provider from CitedRx's 15 scored weight-loss providers based on budget, insurance, and priorities, grounded strictly in CitedRx's own published data.
- [Cheapest GLP-1 Telehealth](https://citedrx.com/weight-loss/cheapest-glp1-telehealth/): The 12 GLP-1 providers with a published starting price, sorted cheapest to most expensive, each paired with its real CitedRx Score.
- [Cheapest ED Telehealth](https://citedrx.com/erectile-dysfunction/cheapest-ed-telehealth/): All 9 ED providers with a published price, sorted cheapest to most expensive, each paired with its real CitedRx Score.
- [Cheapest Menopause / HRT Telehealth](https://citedrx.com/menopause/cheapest-menopause-telehealth/): 7 of CitedRx's 9 menopause providers that publish a single price, sorted cheapest to most expensive.
- [Cheapest Mental Health Telehealth](https://citedrx.com/mental-health/cheapest-mental-health-telehealth/): 6 of CitedRx's 7 mental health providers that publish a price, sorted cheapest to most expensive.

## Research

- [Research Library](https://citedrx.com/research/): Trial data (NEJM, JAMA, Lancet, FDA sources) behind every treatment category, fully cited.
- [GLP-1 Clinical Trial Evidence](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/): STEP, SURMOUNT, and SELECT trial data behind the weight-loss scoring.
- [Ro Review](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/articles/ro-review/): Independent review of Ro, not a sponsored partner.
- [Found GLP-1 Review](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/articles/found-glp1-review/): Independent review of Found, CitedRx's sponsored referral partner, clearly disclosed.
- [Ro vs. LifeMD](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/articles/ro-vs-lifemd/): Head-to-head comparison of CitedRx's two highest-scored GLP-1 providers.
- [Found vs. Ro](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/articles/found-vs-ro/): Factor-by-factor comparison, including where the sponsored partner does not come out ahead.
- [Henry Meds vs. TrimRx](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/articles/henry-meds-vs-trimrx/): Why two similarly priced compounded providers score very differently.
- [Zepbound vs. Wegovy](https://citedrx.com/research/weight-loss/articles/zepbound-vs-wegovy/): Trial-evidence comparison of the two leading branded GLP-1 medications.
- [Hims Review](https://citedrx.com/research/erectile-dysfunction/articles/hims-review/): Independent review of Hims, CitedRx's top-ranked ED provider, not a confirmed referral partner.
- [Hims vs. GoodRx Care](https://citedrx.com/research/erectile-dysfunction/articles/hims-vs-goodrx-care/): Head-to-head comparison of CitedRx's two highest-scored ED providers.
- [Hims vs. Rugiet](https://citedrx.com/research/erectile-dysfunction/articles/hims-vs-rugiet/): Why a compounded 3-in-1 costs far more than FDA-approved generic while scoring far lower.
- [Elektra Health Review](https://citedrx.com/research/menopause/articles/elektra-health-review/): Independent review of Elektra Health, tied for CitedRx's top-ranked menopause provider, not a confirmed referral partner.
- [Elektra Health vs. Gennev](https://citedrx.com/research/menopause/articles/elektra-health-vs-gennev/): Head-to-head comparison of CitedRx's two tied top-scored menopause providers.
- [Alloy vs. Winona](https://citedrx.com/research/menopause/articles/alloy-vs-winona/): Why the provider with the better customer rating scores lower overall.
- [QueerMed Review](https://citedrx.com/research/gender-affirming-hrt/articles/queermed-review/): Independent review of QueerMed, CitedRx's top-ranked gender-affirming HRT provider, not a confirmed referral partner.
- [QueerMed vs. FOLX Health](https://citedrx.com/research/gender-affirming-hrt/articles/queermed-vs-folx-health/): Head-to-head comparison of CitedRx's two highest-scored gender-affirming HRT providers.
- [FOLX Health vs. Circle Medical](https://citedrx.com/research/gender-affirming-hrt/articles/folx-health-vs-circle-medical/): Trans-specialty practice vs. general telehealth platform offering GAHT as one of many services.
- [Brightside Health Review](https://citedrx.com/research/mental-health/articles/brightside-review/): Independent review of Brightside Health, CitedRx's top-ranked mental health provider, not a confirmed referral partner.
- [Brightside Health vs. Rula](https://citedrx.com/research/mental-health/articles/brightside-vs-rula/): Head-to-head comparison of CitedRx's two highest-scored mental health providers.
- [BetterHelp vs. Talkspace](https://citedrx.com/research/mental-health/articles/betterhelp-vs-talkspace/): The two biggest online therapy brands compared, including BetterHelp's 2023 FTC settlement.
